references.observed: The spillway photo shows tall sloped buttresses, the downstream maintenance crossing and the golden plant service building with a rounded grey stair tower.
The roof photo shows the ribbed metal turbine domes along the open-air station, equipment runs between the dam and roof and a walled service platform near the spillway.
The designer records the separate embankments, 154 m spillway, 370 m intake, twelve low-level sluices, two surface gates and ten turbine units.
The project fund lists the 300 m reservoir operating pool.
The Merowe hydroelectric dam is at the pool edge crossing immediately upstream of the mapped Nile tailwater and workers residential area.
